title: Write the baseline and the cross-project audit check
goal: A baseline in SOLUTION, a per-repository check in the audit and a page of copy-paste commands for the owner
acceptance: SOLUTION has the baseline table; the cross-project audit page or tool reads each repository's settings with `gh api` and lists the gaps, an unreadable setting as unknown
A page `docs/reviews/2026-11-security-baseline.md` has, per repository, the exact `gh api` commands to turn each missing setting on and the expected read-back
If the audit check is a tool change, a fixture of a repository with a missing setting fails first and the change never edits it to pass
Does not add a rule section or procedure file (see the F-020 note of 2026-11-26)
Failing test committed first: if a tool reads the settings, a fixture with secret scanning off expects a reported gap; the change never edits that test to pass
privacy: Neutral content only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git. Fixtures are invented.
validation: npm run check:fast; final applicable CI
escalation: Material scope growth or effort increase goes to the owner before adoption

effort.basis: The report's 1 h for the agent side. Estimated 2026-11-26 at agent speed from the report's effort column. Not a measurement.
